transcript.text: Good morning, sir. Lt. Okafor, Signal Officer. I have a time constraint for the communications annex maintenance that I need to get on the record. The UPS test and generator-transfer test are locked in for Wednesday afternoon, and I want to make sure we don't end up with a scheduling conflict before the calendar is published.

transcript.text: Sir, I need to get my constraint on the record as well. I confirmed this morning that the water-treatment contractor is available only Tuesday from 0900 to 1100, and the plant must have a 600-gallon water-truck backup during that outage. The contractor confirmation is in the facilities email but has not yet been entered on the battalion maintenance calendar.
